summary: Guarded pixel-attribute write into a texture buffer. Only when the mode field (this+0x4C) equals 1 and the flags byte (this+0x20) is negative (bit 31 set) does it ensure the texture allocation exists via TextureAllocationWithFormatSizeFlags, then write a4 into the texture buffer at a pixel position computed from the slot index (a2), the dimension field (this+0x24), and the slot-array width. Invoked from sub_4CD8D0 and TelemetryBarIndicatorRenderer.

local_names.flags_byte: flags byte at +0x20; bit 31 must be set
local_names.dimension: row/multiplier dimension used in address calc
local_names.slot_array: pointer to slot array, stride 128, +4 = slot width

operations.description: Both guards gate the write: mode (this+0x4C) must equal 1 AND the flags byte (this+0x20) must be signed-negative (bit 31 set).
Call TextureAllocationWithFormatSizeFlags(this, 0) to ensure the texture allocation exists before writing.
Read the texture buffer base pointer v5 from the texture sub-context: v5 = *(*(this+0x50)+0x20).
Guard the write on v5 being non-zero before computing the destination.
Compute the destination dword: ((a3 + (this+0x24) * slot_width) << 6) + v5 + 24, where slot_width = *(this+0x34 + (a2 << 7) + 4) (slot array stride 128, width field +4).
Write a4 into the computed texture-buffer destination dword.

unresolved: Pixel layout mapping (slot stride << 7, dimension multiply, << 6 row shift, +24 offset) is DERIVED from the decompiled expression; exact pixel format/row-pitch not grounded.
Role of the +24 dword offset inside the texture buffer (header?) not explained.
Mode enum and flags-byte bit 31 meaning not independently confirmed.
